headline: Against the THEORETICALLY-BEST (oracle, overhead-free, fused) PIC, CDC's advantage is CONDITIONAL: CDC wins ONLY at high inj/seq (25%: oraclePIC/CDC 1.05-1.18x) and LOSES at low inj/seq (1-5%: oraclePIC/CDC 0.61-0.99x, oracle-PIC faster). At low inj/seq the oracle PIC recomputes fewer tokens (R+selective p) than CDC (R+boundary window), so a fused PIC matches-or-beats CDC there.
note: Conservative PIC-favorable bound (oracle PIC has zero gather/launch overhead AND skips CDC's boundary window). Removes the re-impl-quality confound the committee flagged (VERDICT-0033). RESULT: CDC's EXP-0026 serving win was partly due to the re-impl PIC's gather overhead; vs a fused/oracle PIC the advantage holds ONLY at high inj/seq.
